The vendor directly providing **Jivo** (also known as **JivoChat**) at **jivochat.com** is **LLC Tecnology Distribution Ltda**.

### Evidence and Citations:
* **Terms of Service (`jivochat.com/terms/`):**  
  > *"Effective as of April 11, 2023, LLC Tecnology Distribution Ltda ('JivoChat,' 'we,' or 'us'), has updated Terms of Service. JivoChat software enables the Subscribers ('Subscriber' or 'you') to communicate with their customers... By downloading and installing the JivoChat software or by accessing, registering and/or using the JivoChat Service, you agree to these Terms of Service..."*
* **Privacy Policy (`jivochat.com/privacy/`):**  
  > *"WHO WE ARE? LLC TECNOLOGY DISTRIBUTION LTDA, (collectively, the 'Company' or 'we' or 'us') the Rua. Neves Armond, 140, Sala 301, Praia Do Suá. Vitória, ES/Brazil, is committed to protecting privacy of your Personal Data..."*
